paragraphs: Rav Pinchas son of Rav Mari.
Mentioned in Zevachim 4b. Dikdukei Soferim reads “son of Rav Ami,” which Hyman considers correct.[^1]

notes.text: דק״ס is read contextually as Dikdukei Soferim in the variant formula; ד: gives Zevachim 4b under the colon convention. Hyman judges son-of-Rav-Ami correct, at the source’s categorical force, while the heading retains Rav Mari. Neither a fresh witness collation nor an independent Mari/Ami identity adjudication is claimed. All three separate Rav titles are full.
